feature: Updated existing Convert to CPD context-menu action

geometry_source.provenance: Four archived MVP canonical starts, with PDB and graph source digests and ordered residue indices in the portable asset. No parameter assets are promoted.
geometry_source.endpoint_mapping: Read from each archived graph.json; cis-anti-I uses residues 2/5, the syn cases use 3/4.
geometry_source.identity_check: All four signed-volume stereocenter checks pass for each extracted core.

behavior: Exactly two unused ordinary or junction extra thymines, including crossover selections whose inserts total two thymines.
Selection order defines endpoint 1/2 and is displayed in the popup.
One proper rigid fit of the MVP base pair to the selected ring coordinates. Only base atoms are overridden; no nucleotide transforms, sugar atoms or phosphate atoms are moved.
Preview and conversion use the same placement function. Preview includes real bonded flanking residues, strand colors, same/different-strand label, orbit/zoom and original/product toggle.
Crosslinks come from the chemical definition, including anti C5-C6/C6-C5 connectivity. Full slabs derive their poses from the same base coordinates.
Preview revisions are checked at commit. A stale preview cannot convert; the user can explicitly refresh it.
Removal restores original ordinary slabs and atom coordinates. Legacy full-residue conversion/relaxation remains available through its existing API for compatibility.
limits: Manual visual construction only; simulation remains blocked for this placement method.
Backbone-fixed construction can stretch sugar-base attachments or create clashes. No local backbone relaxation is performed.

The tested trans-syn-II different-strand fixture has attachment lengths approximately 4.05 and 4.12 angstrom. A subsequent physically connected preparation should consider local backbone relaxation with explicit user authorization.
Other ordered isomers lack admitted MVP authoring cores and are not offered.
The new bases-only feature records undo/history snapshots; native recipe regeneration certification is not added by this change.
